from __future__ import annotations
from dataclasses import dataclass

@dataclass(kw_only=True)
class Pet:
    _id: str
    name: str | None = None

AllPets = list[Pet]

AllPetPages = list[AllPets]

PetIndex = dict[str, Pet]

@dataclass(kw_only=True)
class ItemsItem:
    id: str | None = None

Items = list[ItemsItem]
